notes: M07-09 provider-dependency review. Records every external feed/provider this implementation depends on, its lifecycle status, and the required behaviour when it is unavailable: the system reports stale/unknown for the affected capability and keeps other capabilities usable. No provider is assumed current or permanently available; no historical dataset is assumed to still be produced. References [P0x] are the plan's revalidation list.

dependencies.failure_mode: collection fails closed with exit 4; no partial report is written
dependencies.assumption: git is installed and pinned by version evidence captured per scan
dependencies.rights: tool licence reviewed; no data redistribution

used_for: explicit single exact package/version query through the fixed OSV API endpoint
dependencies.failure_mode: query transport or response validation fails closed; a missing/withdrawn advisory is unknown, never 'not vulnerable'; a next_page_token is exposed as more_available and is not treated as complete
dependencies.assumption: only the bounded exact-version-string request is implemented; OSV matches versions fuzzily, the capture time does not establish feed freshness, bulk lockfile collection and pagination continuation remain open, and OSV data can be incomplete or stale
dependencies.rights: aggregated advisory records retain source IDs and links; underlying source terms vary, so public redistribution is not enabled and attribution is required per record

dependencies.failure_mode: adapter absent; any future use must carry coverage/origin and is not enabled here
dependencies.assumption: do not assume API stability or coverage without a captured fixture
dependencies.rights: review required before enabling; see source-review register process

dependencies.failure_mode: never consumed; importing it would risk a popularity/safety claim, which is prohibited (S011, R030)
dependencies.assumption: a retired external dataset is not assumed current; it is not consumed at all

used_for: bounded captured package lookup adapter (live transport disabled)
dependencies.failure_mode: live provider is not enabled; captured adapter rejects malformed records, retains provenance/coverage, and never treats a provider claim as a primitive fact
dependencies.assumption: revisit lifecycle and data-specific rights before enabling transport
dependencies.rights: metadata-only capture review recorded in source-review register; live use still requires revalidation

used_for: defines how a future reproducibility claim must be stated
dependencies.failure_mode: not implemented; build success is never equated with reproducibility
dependencies.assumption: a reproducibility claim requires defined source+environment+instructions
